title: Refractor
description: Records from Herb's top songs printed as chrome refractor trading cards: the cover as the photo, a foil-stamped nameplate in a colour pulled from the art, a year roundel, and a numbered tracklist back. Tilt one and a diffraction grating splits the light across the chrome while the print stays matte; flick it hard and the next card spins in edge-on.
intent: One optical material finished to the edge on a believable premium card: a grating equation drives the rainbow, a chrome map generated from each cover keeps the print matte, and the card design follows a modern chrome set, with a silver border, a team-colour nameplate and a printed back.
